name: host-operations
description: Diagnose GPU ownership and credential-loading boundaries without exposing secrets or making unreviewed host changes.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose GPU and credential ownership safely.
interface.longDescription: Provides evidence-first workflows for clearing a Windows NVIDIA compute lane and tracing environment credential sources across shells, WSL, containers, and services.
defaultPrompt: Find what is using this NVIDIA GPU and verify a clean compute lane.
Trace why this process cannot see its expected environment credential.
Separate WDDM reservation from an active CUDA allocation.
